title: Percival Lowell's Martian irrigation canals

tellings.quote: on Mars but LEL went as far as to claim that parts of these dark areas and patterns were purposefully built irrigation systems designed by a martian civilization

plain: The astronomer Percival Lowell claimed that some of the dark areas and patterns seen on Mars were irrigation canals built on purpose by a Martian civilisation. Michels tells this himself, as history, in an episode with Joe McMoneagle, a man known for "remote viewing," the claimed ability to see distant places with the mind, saying Lowell "went as far as to claim" the patterns were "purposefully built." He raises it as an early case of someone seeing signs of intelligent life on Mars.
